prose: Clive de Carle returns for our yearly health check up to talk about his newest findings and products. In the first hour you'll learn about Methylene Blue, liver, gallbladder, and heavy metals detox, magnesium, vitamin B, C and K2, reversing tooth decay, getting chlorine and fluoride out of your water, sodium bicarbonate, and more.
ext: Clive shares personal out of body experiences, getting the cow-poke out of people's systems, the potential next round of cooties paranoia, carbon and charcoal, cryotherapy and other experimental treatments, hydrogen, allergies solutions, and communicating with our body's innate intelligence.
